resources.string: Cosmos shows ESA/Hubble and ESA/Webb space imagery as your TV screensaver. Each image is checked individually for a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence before it is downloaded, and its full credit is shown on screen. To use it, open your TV\'s screensaver settings and select Cosmos.
Unable to open screensaver settings automatically. Open them from your TV\'s system settings and select Cosmos.
All image sources are switched off.

Cosmos connects only to esahubble.org and esawebb.org. It has no account, analytics, tracking or advertising, and everything it downloads stays on this TV. Images that do not clearly carry an applicable licence are skipped.
